correctness.rationale: Using the normal basis theorem, F_{q^d} is the cyclic F_q[T] module F_q[T]/(T^d-1), including repeated roots. Every invariant subspace is W_f=ker f(sigma) and has dimension deg f. Complete Fourier descent supplies independent subfield seeds; their conjugate-span sum has annihilator lcm of seed F_q-orders. CRT yields each cumulative primary bound q^{deg(P) sum_i min(j,a_iP)}, and finite differences give all exact counts. A character of exponent N gives an orbit of length d, so no rank-support divisor is absent. Six exhaustive cyclic and one direct noncyclic DFT checks corroborate critical finite instances; none is used in place of the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The original code family has a known positional Hamming enumerator; its field-valued coordinate-span rank is a different natural rank-metric invariant. The theorem classifies all possible invariant rank-support subspaces and counts the populations of every support for ALL finite abelian groups and fields, including nonsemisimple repeated-root cases. It yields a computable exact full-rank probability, a rank-weight benchmark for the novel family, and structural information unavailable from the positional Hamming formula. No implementation gain is presumed.
